description: This file defines the EntityEcaRule class, which implements entity event-condition-action rules within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes logic for evaluating conditions and executing actions based on entity events.

classes.name: EntityEcaRule
classes.description: Represents an entity event-condition-action rule, capable of evaluating conditions and executing actions based on entity events within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: EntityEcaRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule based on an XML element, parsing conditions and actions.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity associated with this rule.

methods.name: getOperationName
methods.description: Returns the operation name associated with this rule.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the event name associated with this rule.

methods.name: getRunOnError
methods.description: Indicates whether the rule should run on error.

methods.name: getActionsAndSets
methods.description: Returns the list of actions and set operations associated with this rule.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of conditions for this rule.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule against a given entity event, executing actions if conditions are met.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Deprecated method to enable or disable the rule.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the rule is enabled.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the rule object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityEcaRule object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the rule.
